newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's says maintains Katokichi's Baa3 rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says maintains Katokichi's Baa3 rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Monday it had maintained its Baa3 rating on unsecured long-term bonds of Japanese frozen food producer Katokichi Co Ltd.

The rating confirmation was based on Moody's expectation that the company will be able to maintain its leading position in the domestic frozen foods market, the credit rating firm said in a statement.
The confirmation also took into consideration the downside risk of the company's participation in the restoration of a failed take-out sushi chain, Kyotaru Co Ltd.
Affected by Moody's rating confirmation were Katokichi's $190 million 0.75 percent eurobonds with warrants due 1997 and 15 billion yen 3.7 percent domestic convertible bonds due 1999.
